This is how service and hospitality should be. Take care, my friend..
Apr 2025 • Solo
Passing through, I saw the sign for pizza and decided to venture in. The owner was there smoking his shikha pipe and drinking his Bitter Melon tea. It hadn’t opened yet but he still offered me some of his tea (which I accepted). Ordered a wonderfully delicious seafood fettuccine and spring roll dinner - so good. What service! He even came running after me to tell me they forgot the chopsticks with my order. (I didn’t have the heart to tell him; I don’t use chopsticks)! I have those chopsticks at home as a reminder of a great meal and an even better human being. Take care, my friend!
